title: Will Bravo Team up with Brecreation for new single "XO Hopscotch"
htmlContent:
The collaboration between Will Bravo and Brecreation on the new record “XO Hopscotch” is that authentic Hip Hop that keeps the soul in this genre. The production is hard and soul and it matched, with incredible rhyming by the legendary emcee to make everything click just right for purists everywhere.
